races.name: Beastfolk
races.description: A race that can freely change between their true animal form and a more a human form. They possess immense physical prowess and regenerative capabilities that let them fight without rest.

races.description: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Spirit Beast
races.description: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Divine Beast
races.description: Beastfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Harpy
races.description: A race of winged Majin with capability to cancel out flight spell and are often referred to as the rulers of the skies.

races.name: Harpy Queen
races.description: A Queen Species of Harpy with the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth.

races.name: Spirit Bird
races.description: Harpy that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Divine Bird
races.description: Harpy that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Ogre
races.description: A sprite race descended from fire elementals. They possess immense physical capabilities and a strong Japanese lineage.

races.name: Kijin
races.description: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans descended from Fire Elementals. They have an average lifespan of over a thousand years

races.name: Enlightened Ogre
races.description: Ogre that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Mystic Oni
races.description: The result of Kijin fully returning to their roots as Elementals, making them Spiritual Lifeforms.

races.name: Wicked Oni
races.description: A variant of Oni, possessing an essence that leans closer towards that of a Daemon rather than that of a pure Elemental.

races.name: Spirit Oni
races.description: Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Death Oni
races.description: Wicked Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Divine Oni
races.description: Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Divine Fighter
races.description: Wicked Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Goblin
races.description: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans. They seem to be descended from the offspring of Dwarves and Oni.

races.name: Hobgoblin
races.description: The evolved form of male Goblins that is ranked D on average.

races.name: Enlightened Hobgoblin
races.description: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Hobgoblin Saint
races.description: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Giant
races.description: A race of powerful Majin most notable for their incredible physical capabilities and Magic Resistance.

races.name: Ancient Giant
races.description: Ancient form of Giants with even more incredible physical capabilities and abilities.

races.name: Divine Giant
races.description: A godly race born from the earth itself, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Orc
races.description: A race of beastfolk who lost the ability to shift between man and beast, resulting in a permanent mix of the two. Their physical strength is greater than average but pails in comparison to their original strength as beastfolk.

races.name: High Orc
races.description: The evolved form of Orcs. They are smarter than Orcs while preserving the Orc race's special characteristics, with appearance virtually identical to regular Orcs.

races.name: Spirit Boar
races.description: Orc that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Orc Lord
races.description: A very rare and powerful member of the Orc race with high intelligence who appears roughly every few centuries.

races.name: Orc Disaster
races.description: The evolution of an Orc Lord that is a Demon Lord Seed.

races.name: Divine Boar
races.description: Orc that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.description: A race of scaled people descended from dragons. Their webbed feet give them an advantage in wet terrain.

races.name: Divine Dragon
races.description: Dragonewt that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.description: A race of Majin with nearly eternal life. Although they can reproduce, they normally abstain. Hosting overwhelming magical energy and vitality, their flesh never decays.

races.name: Vampire Overcomer
races.description: Vampires that have evolved to overcome their weakness against the sun.

races.name: Vampire Lord
races.description: A vampire among the loftiest levels of power, comparable to a Demon Lord.

races.name: Divine Vampire
races.description: Vampire that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Wight
races.description: A Demi-Spiritual skeletal Undead Monster, highly weakened by sunlight.

races.name: Wight King
races.description: A type of Undead Monster and an evolution of Wights. They possess fearsome power comparable to that of Demon Lord Seeds.

races.name: Spirit Skeleton
races.description: Wight that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

races.name: Divine Skeleton
races.description: Wight that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

races.name: Lesser Daemon
races.description: The lowest level of the daemon race. They spontaneously come into existence within the Daemon Realm where they slowly accumulate experience from fighting and being summoned before eventually evolving into greater daemons.
traits: EP is limited in the central world

races.name: Greater Daemon
races.description: The daemon race that lesser daemons evolve to when they develop their ego and accumulate enough power.
traits: EP is limited in the central world

races.name: Arch Daemon
races.description: The peak evolutionary stage that can be reached by daemons in the Daemon Realm. Only the most powerful of greater daemons can ascend to this height.
traits: EP is limited in the central world

races.name: Daemon Lord
races.description: One of the most powerful evolutionary stages of daemons, achieved only by the most powerful arch daemons.
traits: EP is limited in the central world

races.name: Devil Lord
races.description: The final stage of evolution for daemons. One emerges when a daemon meets all three requirements of a name, material body, and divinity.

enchantments.name: Sturdy

enchantments.name: Swift

enchantments.name: Blessing of Transcendence

enchantments.name: Tsukumogami
enchantments.description: Makes only the owner of the weapon be able to use its full potential.

enchantments.name: Blessing of Vigor
enchantments.description: Increases the amount of Energy the weapon and its wielder gain.

enchantments.name: Blessing of Vitality
